So, this passage emphasizes working wholeheartedly and not just for people but for the Lord. Another passage that comes to mind is Colossians 3:23-24, which says, "Whatever you do, work at it with all your heart, as working for the Lord, not for men, since you know that you will receive an inheritance from the Lord as a reward."
